specification.landscape: 50 by 50 torus; capacity 0 to 4. Published Figure 8 recovers all 2,500 cells, exactly matching retained NetLogo 5.3.1 and 6.1.1 sugar-map.txt files; original author file identity remains unverified.
specification.vision: Random integer 1 through 5; low vision 1 through 3
specification.metabolism: Random integer 1 through 4; low metabolism 1 through 2
specification.movement: Random sequential agents; cardinal visible unoccupied cells plus current cell; maximize sugar, then minimize distance, then random ties
order: All patches grow by 1 up to capacity
Tax when time modulo 5 equals zero
Remove agents with sugar at most zero
specification.schedule: 200 entries: 4 agent classes by 5 resource-region types by 10 tax cycles
specification.reduction: Nearest-neighbor landscape resampling; population scaled; vision scaled with grid size, but high vision fixed to 2 for sizes 10 and 5; metabolism unchanged
